title: Streamline Your AL Development with Global NuGet Symbols
summary: Business Central AL 17.0 allows developers to download Business Central symbols from Global NuGet feeds instead of needing a live client environment or copying symbols from other projects. This streamlines AL extension development by adding al.symbolsCountryRegion configuration and using a new download symbols command in Visual Studio Code.
key_points: AL 17.0 introduces the ability to download symbols from Global NuGet feeds
Configure al.symbolsCountryRegion in .VSCode/Settings.json with your country region code (e.g., 'us')
New 'AL: Download symbols from global sources' command available in Visual Studio Code
Eliminates the need to log into a Business Central environment or copy symbols from other projects
features: Download symbols from global sources command

quotes.text: You can download symbols from the Global NuGet feeds.
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces the core capability that solves the problem of needing a live Business Central environment for development

quotes.text: No need to log into a Business Central environment, no accidentally copying old resources from an old project.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the practical benefits and workflow improvements of using the new Global NuGet approach
